name: tower-tracker
description: Self-hosted, single-user, Trello-style issue tracker for a homelab

scripts.build: npm run build -w @tt/web && npm run build -w @tt/server && node scripts/check-dist.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @tt/shared && npm run typecheck -w @tt/server && npm run typecheck -w @tt/web
